workspace.text:

- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH Elena and David are free next week (for a 30-min meeting):

- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Comparing this with the times you provided for Priya and Marcus:
- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

I don't see any overlapping time slots between the two sets. There appears to be NO time next week when all four partners are free. 

Can you please double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars to confirm there are no other times when both are free that you might have missed? If not, we may need to report this as infeasible.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

- Monday: 09:00 or 09:30 start (09:00-10:00 block)
- Tuesday: 13:00, 13:30, or 16:30 start
- Wednesday: 15:00 or 15:30 start
- Thursday: 10:00 start only
- Friday: 11:00 or 11:30 start

Comparing with your Elena+David availability (Mon 11:00-12:00, Tue 09:00-10:00, Wed 13:00-14:00, Thu 09:30-10:00/14:30-15:30, Fri 15:00-16:00), there is indeed NO overlapping time.

Before we report infeasible, could you please double-check Elena and David's calendars to make sure you haven't missed any slots? Specifically, are they definitely NOT free at any of these times: Mon 09:00-10:00, Tue 13:00-14:00 or 16:30-17:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Thu 10:00-10:30, Fri 11:00-12:00?
